shab.definition:
n. The itch in animals; also, a scab.
v. t. To play mean tricks; to act shabbily.
v. t. To scratch; to rub.
shab.translation: abbr. soft and hard acids and bases 软硬酸基

shaba.translation: 沙巴区[扎伊尔行政区名](旧称加丹加省)

shaban.translation: 舍尔邦月(伊斯兰教历八月)

shabani.translation: [地名] [津巴布韦] 沙巴尼（兹维沙瓦内的旧称）

shabbat.translation: n. （犹太教）安息日（等于Shabbos, Shabbas）

shabbier.definition:
s. showing signs of wear and tear
s. mean and unworthy and despicable
shabbier.translation: a. （指东西）因使用过久或照管不善而破旧的( shabby的比较级 ); 衣衫褴褛的; 卑鄙的; 下流的

shabbiest.definition:
s. showing signs of wear and tear
s. mean and unworthy and despicable
shabbiest.translation: a. （指东西）因使用过久或照管不善而破旧的( shabby的最高级 ); 衣衫褴褛的; 卑鄙的; 下流的

shabbily.definition:
r. so as to appear worn and threadbare or dilapidated
r. in a mean and ungenerous manner
shabbily.translation: adv. 衣衫褴褛地, 不体面地, 卑鄙地

shabbiness.definition: n. a lack of elegance as a consequence of wearing threadbare or dirty clothing
shabbiness.translation: n. 衣衫褴褛, 吝啬, 卑鄙

shabble.definition:
n. Alt. of Shabble
n. A kind of crooked sword or hanger.

shabby.definition: s. mean and unworthy and despicable
shabby.translation: a. 衣衫褴褛的, 低劣的, 破旧的, 吝啬的, 卑鄙的

shabby-genteel.definition: s. trying to maintain dignity and self respect despite shabbiness

shabrack.definition: n. The saddlecloth or housing of a cavalry horse.

shabri.translation: 白色或银灰色(野山羊), 羊绒

shabu.definition: n an amphetamine derivative (trade name Methedrine) used in the form of a crystalline hydrochloride; used as a stimulant to the nervous system and as an appetite suppressant

shabuoth.definition: n. (Judaism) Jewish holy day celebrated on the sixth of Sivan to celebrate Moses receiving the Ten Commandments
